caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and features a composition framed within a rounded arch. Inside the arch, there is a carved, relief-like depiction of a draped, standing female figure on the left, bent forward with her head resting on her forearm, which is placed atop a rectangular pedestal or tomb. To the right of the pedestal stands a tree with a thick trunk and several large, stylized leaves curving outward in multiple directions. The background and objects are shaded to suggest three-dimensional form, and the lines are smooth and rounded. The scene is symmetrical, with the figure and tree positioned on either side of the central pedestal. The artist’s name, Cordena Jackson, appears in small text at the bottom right outside the inner border.
title: Carving for a Tombstone
